import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        long cap, cost, flow;
        Edge(int from, int to, long cap, long cost) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        long first, second;
        Pair(long first, long second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
        public int compareTo(Pair other) {
            return Long.compare(this.first, other.first);
        }
    }

    static class PriorityQueue<T extends Comparable<T>> extends java.util.PriorityQueue<T> {
        public PriorityQueue(int initialCapacity) {
            super(initialCapacity);
        }
    }

    static class FastReader {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;
        public FastReader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }
        String next() {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreElements()) {
                try {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    e.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }
        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
        double nextDouble() {
            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }
        String nextLine() {
            String str = "";
            try {
                str = br.readLine();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
            }
            return str;
        }
    }

    static FastReader sc = new FastReader();
    static PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        edges.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, cost));
        g[u].add(edges.size() - 1);
        edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, -cost));
        g[v].add(edges.size() - 1);
    }

    static void fordBellman(int s, int n) {
        Arrays.fill(phi, Long.MAX_VALUE);
        phi[s] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < edges.size(); j++) {
                if (edges.get(j).cap == edges.get(j).flow) continue;
                int from = edges.get(j).from;
                int to = edges.get(j).to;
                long len = edges.get(j).cost;
                if (phi[from] == Long.MAX_VALUE) continue;
                phi[to] = Math.min(phi[to], phi[from] + len);
            }
        }
    }

    static void dijkstra(int s) {
        Arrays.fill(d, Long.MAX_VALUE);
        d[s] = 0;
        PriorityQueue<Pair> q = new PriorityQueue<>(edges.size());
        q.add(new Pair(0, s));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll().second;
            for (int i = 0; i < g[v].size(); i++) {
                int eid = g[v].get(i);
                if (edges.get(eid).cap == edges.get(eid).flow) continue;
                int to = edges.get(eid).to;
                long len = edges.get(eid).cost + phi[v] - phi[to];
                if (d[v] + len < d[to]) {
                    q.remove(new Pair(d[to], to));
                    d[to] = d[v] + len;
                    par[to] = eid;
                    q.add(new Pair(d[to], to));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static Pair minCostMaxFlow(int s, int t) {
        fordBellman(s, 50);
        dijkstra(s);
        long flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (true) {
            if (d[t] == Long.MAX_VALUE) break;
            long pushed = Long.MAX_VALUE, sum = 0;
            for (int tmp = t; tmp != s; ) {
                int eid = par[tmp];
                pushed = Math.min(pushed, edges.get(eid).cap - edges.get(eid).flow);
                sum += edges.get(eid).cost;
                tmp = edges.get(eid).from;
            }
            flow += pushed;
            cost += pushed * sum;
            for (int tmp = t; tmp != s; ) {
                int eid = par[tmp];
                edges.get(eid).flow += pushed;
                edges.get(eid ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                tmp = edges.get(eid).from;
            }
            dijkstra(s);
            for (int i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
                phi[i] = d[i];
            }
        }
        return new Pair(cost, flow);
    }

    static void solve() {
        int n = sc.nextInt(), m = sc.nextInt(), k = sc.nextInt(), c = sc.nextInt(), d = sc.nextInt();
        int[] cnts = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int ai = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            cnts[ai]++;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            addEdge(5000, i, cnts[i], 0);
        }
        for (int it = 0; it < m; it++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1, v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 99; i++) {
                long cost = d;
                for (int j = 0; j < 50; j++) {
                    addEdge(u + i * 50, v + (i + 1) * 50, 1, cost);
                    addEdge(v + i * 50, u + (i + 1) * 50, 1, cost);
                    cost += 2 * d;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 99; i++) {
            addEdge(0 + i * 50, 5001, Long.MAX_VALUE, c * i);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 99; j++) {
                addEdge(i + j * 50, i + (j + 1) * 50, Long.MAX_VALUE, 0);
            }
        }
        Pair p = minCostMaxFlow(5000, 5001);
        assert (p.second == k);
        out.println(p.first);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
        out.close();
    }

    static ArrayList<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[5007];
    static long[] d = new long[5007];
    static long[] phi = new long[5007];
    static int[] par = new int[5007];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 5007; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }
}
